format: Top-level startups array; each member independently conforms to the existing strict startupRecordSchema. The wrapper is staging metadata, not a new API schema.
rules: No schema/API changes, no production overlay edits, no investor graph entities or edges, no seed approval and no deployment.
Cargamos is excluded because its research disposition is deferred; all other 23 records are staged research candidates, not production-accepted records.

Known founded_year is projected only from an explicit non-null company-founding assertion; month/year precision, qualifications and conflicts remain in profile_facts. Idea origin, programme year and legal incorporation are separate.

Historical/undated headquarters, incorporation, geography, founder-role observations, aliases and review gaps are carried as sourced profile_facts. Stori country-level Mexico-based evidence is not labelled a city/headquarters fact.
Yalo is explicitly a cross-border country-assignment review candidate with Mexico operations and self-reported US headquarters. Apli is explicitly historical/acquired.
Only day-precision announcement dates enter announced_on. Year/month/update/report dates and approximate closing dates remain text.
Unknown values are omitted from strict legacy fields, never written as zero or an invented date/currency. No funding total is derived.
Debt/mixed facilities and conditional announced-but-unclosed amounts remain amount_text because the legacy funding view has no transaction-kind/amount-basis/completion discriminator.
Where currency requires a different source, the numeric pair is withheld from the single-source legacy fields and both source observations are retained in facts/notes.

Participants remain source-specific profile observations, with event scopes, stated_role qualifiers and financing components. Explicit arranger, facility-provider and venture-debt-partner wording takes precedence over a generic participant role. No new canonical investor/person entities, individual allocation or current ownership is inferred.

Konfio September 2021 extension is held for amount/role conflict. The later-updated Sofia US$21M post is held as a possible duplicate of the earlier Kfund-led post, not counted as a proven second transaction.
No complete founder roster, capital history, corporate-status registry or national population denominator is claimed.

Primary-source rereview supersedes the Stori fragment arranger wording: Davidson Kempner is projected as credit facility provider/lender. The earlier label is retained only as a superseded audit input. HSBC in the Justo financing remains an arranger.
